title: When the Future Suddenly Becomes Visible
editorialPrinciples: Narration blocks are semantic/TTS units, not visual shots.
Audio is the master timeline; visual boundaries must never alter narration continuity.
Each slot must perform an editorial function within the surrounding sequence.
Prefer natural behavior, environments, objects, movement, architecture, and atmospheric shots over stock-actor overload.
Prefer video first; photos are fallback.
Do not approve production assets solely from textual metadata when visual previews are available.
One selected sourcing slot normally maps to one visual shot and one source use.
Do not silently loop or duplicate assets to satisfy shot counts.

notes: Direct elderly/caregiving imagery is intentionally concentrated in a minority of slots.
Mid-episode sections deliberately shift toward domestic space, routine, movement, planning objects, and environmental change.
Avoid repeated runs of sad elderly portraits, medication, hospital, wheelchair, lonely windows, or mortality-coded stock imagery.
N011-N013 and N018 require especially careful preview review because impermanence, anticipatory grief, and endings easily attract cliché symbolism.

blocks.visualArc: ordinary evening → subtle physical difficulty → disrupted normality

slots.editorialFunction: Establish an ordinary domestic evening before anything feels wrong.
slots.visualIntent: A lived-in bedroom or hallway at night with warm practical light and no visible crisis.

slots.editorialFunction: Introduce physical effort without turning the moment into a medical emergency.
slots.visualIntent: An older adult slowly shifting position or preparing to get out of bed, preferably partial body, back, or hands rather than expressive acting.
slots.query: senior man getting out of bed home natural

slots.editorialFunction: Let the ordinary scene become subtly unstable without escalating into drama.
slots.visualIntent: A quiet bedside moment with hesitant movement, a hand finding support, or a pause before standing.
slots.query: older man bedside slow movement home
